name: Zichri
overview: Zichri is a male figure from the tribe of Benjamin, identified uniquely as the son of Shashak. There are no additional notes or details about his life or role beyond this familial connection. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical.
namesAndTitles: The name Zichri means "YHWH remembers," reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew meaning. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God, but it carries a reminder of God's faithfulness and memory toward His people.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Zichri as the son of Shashak, establishing his immediate paternal lineage. Beyond this, no further family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zichri's significance lies mainly in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, highlighting the preservation of tribal identity and heritage in Israel. His mention in 1 Chronicles 8:23 serves to connect the lineage of Benjaminite families, underscoring the faithfulness of God in maintaining His covenant people through generations.
